svg.text: K10 KÜCHENGERÄT — household appliances fed by a small hand
A thermo-cooker, a domino, a mini oven and a slim dishwasher used as bought; bought gadgets cut; one 4-axis hand.
4 motion actuators · 3 dynamic seals (Z band, Y band, roll lip seal)
cell machine part €2,520 (K9c €4,313) · whole machine ≈ €3.0–3.3 k
FRONT VIEW (fronts and glazed panels removed)
TOP VIEW (cell at deck level z 870)
board on lazy susan = serve zone
dishwasher door swings over the cooker
DISHWASHER DOOR FIXES THE PHASES (open = orange)
Clean ware lives in the shut dishwasher; all ware for a menu comes out before any food is opened.
1 P0 ware out of the dishwasher
3 P1 chop in cooker, press garlic
hub, ring coil, press cup → bought thermo-cooker (€219)
well, wash parts → slim dishwasher as bought
dicer, blade post → garlic press, ricer, push dicer, mandoline, peeler
roll canned coupling → PTFE lip seal (6 → 4 actuators)

g.text: 1/8 P0: the hook rod opens the dishwasher door, racks out; pots, tools, plates taken out before any food is opened
2/8 P1: box lowered; cucumber on the spit peeled against the peeler post, then sliced on the mandoline
3/8 P1: carrot and onion chopped in the thermo-cooker (10 s); garlic pressed in its skin at the lever seat
4/8 P2: domino idle, door open: board, knives and gadgets go into the dishwasher; door shut
5/8 P3: mince seared on the front zone, then moved into the cooker jug, which simmers and stirs it
6/8 P3: pasta water from the 85 °C boiler boils on the front zone; pasta lifted out in its basket
7/8 P4: plates warm from the oven to the serve zone; sauce ladled from the jug; the bay panel unlocks
8/8 P5: plates back, scraps over the chute, everything into the dishwasher; hygiene programme; nozzle rail rinses
